title: Trupanion Claim Reimbursement Leaderboard
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trupanion:claim reimbursement_usd=*
| stats sum(reimbursement_usd) as total_value, avg(reimbursement_usd) as avg_value by pet_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pet values by total and average reimbursement across Trupanion claim events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `reimbursement_usd` values for each Trupanion claim event and review total and average reimbursement by pet.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total reimbursement.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which pet shows the biggest reimbursement numbers in your Trupanion claim data.
